input.expected_problem: Bot may get confused by caller who changes their mind mid-conversation

conversation.content: Hello, this is Monica at Demo Clinic Alpha. How can I help you?
Hi, I think I need to schedule an appointment.
Sure! What would the appointment be for?
Actually, wait. Before I do that - do you know if my lab results are back? I had blood work last week.
I can help you check on that. Were there any specific tests done, or just general blood work?
It was just general blood work. But, hmm, actually never mind the labs. Let me just schedule the appointment. But wait - what are your hours? I need to figure out when I can come in.
Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so you're open until 5. That might work. Actually, can I check on those lab results first after all? Then I'll know if I even need to come in.
Got it! I can help you check on that. Since it was general blood work, I’ll note that. Were you feeling anxious about the results at all?
Oh, I was just a bit worried, but I'm trying not to stress too much. Okay. Actually, I changed my mind, I do want to schedule the appointment either way. Sorry, I know I'm all over the place today.
No problem at all! What would the appointment be for?
Sorry, let me focus. I need to: one, check my lab results, and two, schedule a follow-up regardless of the results. Can we do both?
I can help you with that! First, I'll need to verify your identity to check on your lab results. Can I have your full name?
Sure! My name is Michelle Lee.
Thank you, Michelle. And what is your date of birth?
My date of birth is April 22, 1988.
I'm sorry, I wasn't able to verify your identity. Let me connect you with someone who can help.
Oh, okay! I understand. Thank you for your help so far. Sorry for being all over the place today.
